task: Build a working web scraper: fetch a public webpage using requests, extract all hyperlinks using BeautifulSoup, filter to external links only, write results to a CSV file, include error handling for b

goal: Scaffold project: create scraper.py with all required imports and a main() skeleton
Implement fetch_page(url) that retrieves a webpage with requests and returns the HTML text
Implement extract_links(html, base_url) that parses HTML and returns all hyperlinks
Implement filter_external(links, base_url) that keeps only external (different-domain) links and excludes non-web URLs
Implement write_csv(links, output_file) that writes extracted links to a CSV file
Add error handling to fetch_page: catch network errors, timeouts, and bad HTTP status codes
Implement main() to orchestrate the full pipeline: parse CLI args, call each function in order, report results
Write a README.md documenting dependencies, installation, usage, and example commands
